dataset.name: scifact-q50-c300
dataset.description: BEIR SciFact test split: 50 claims, 300 abstracts (55 relevant + 245 random distractors).
notes: SciFact: Wadden et al., 'Fact or Fiction: Verifying Scientific Claims', EMNLP 2020. Licence CC BY-NC 2.0. BEIR packaging: Thakur et al., NeurIPS 2021 Datasets & Benchmarks.
Deterministic subset (seed hybrid-rag-bench/scifact-subset-v1). Distractors are random, not hard negatives, so this is easier than full-corpus BEIR and NOT comparable to published BEIR nDCG@10.
Abstracts are chunked at <=600 characters; relevance is per abstract, so several chunks of one abstract earn credit once.

pipeline.fts: simple ∪ spanish ∪ english tsvector; websearch_to_tsquery; ts_rank_cd

caveats: Small benchmark: one sample per question and mode; differences of one question move split means by 1/n.
Ranking metrics use binary relevance over evidence ids; repeated evidence earns no extra credit.
Retrieval only: no answer generation, so context quality is a proxy for downstream answer quality.
